fact: Minister Faya François Bourouno launched the deployment phase of the e-Services project, the national e-Services platform built inside ANDE under WARDIP Guinée to give citizens and businesses access to administrative services, with several digitalised public services targeted by the end of the first half of 2026.
La Guinee Info reports the Ministry of Livestock officially launched Ngaynaako, a digital one-stop portal where livestock actors can make requests online with set deadlines.

The Presidency's communication office says the Ministry of Fisheries and Maritime Economy officially launched KONKÖE (SIGPEM) on 26 October 2026, a platform for fishing licences and certificates, with the first licence signed through it.

The government launched Konkoe (SIGPEM) on 26 October 2026, a digital one-stop platform where artisanal and industrial fishers apply for licences and track files from phone or computer, per the fisheries minister.

Guinea launched KONKOE (SIGPEM) on 26 October 2026, a digital platform dematerialising fishing licence and vessel-register procedures, with a first licence signed at launch and user service announced from 1 November 2026.
